scope: Prevent catalog-derived free text from being replayed into another model decision during the same turn; keep dynamic shopping taxonomy and prior catalog proposals out of the planner system prompt.
regression_assertions: A malicious instruction placed in a catalog product name does not trigger a second model-selected add_to_cart call.
The model provider is called once by the catalog agent flow and receives no role=tool catalog observation.
Catalog taxonomy labels, including an injected instruction-like label, are not included in planner provider messages.
Prior proposed product names and proposed_items are omitted from later mission-planner context.
The advisory shopping plan does not mutate the cart.

targeted.scope: Focused product-knowledge, catalog-history isolation, streaming follow-up, mission prompt and mission API regressions

static_checks.command: uv run ruff check backend tests evaluation
uv run python -m compileall -q backend evaluation tests

static_checks.result: Passed; Git emitted only an LF-to-CRLF working-copy warning for the Markdown report

limitations: Tests use scripted/local providers; no live Groq adversarial request was run.
No browser, voice, production catalog, load, or independent human security evaluation was run.
These regressions cover the exercised data-flow path and do not certify the system against all prompt-injection attacks.
The existing protected blind-set, independent relevance review, answer-quality review, production provider/browser checks, and load-test gates remain unmet.
